question.text: Penalty for non-compliance with SEBI (AIF) Regulations 2012 starts at:

answer.text: Rs. 1 lakh minimum, up to Rs. 1 lakh per day or Rs. 1 crore or 3x gains, whichever higher

explanation.text: The Logic: Per Section 5.1 / Section 15EA SEBI Act 1992, minimum Rs. 1 lakh, extending up to Rs. 1 lakh per day or Rs. 1 crore or 3× gains. The Trap: Flat/no penalty is incorrect. Cross-Exam Context: Clear enforcement regime. Distributor's Pro-Tip: Maintain compliance calendars to avoid daily-accrual penalties.
